workingTreeInstall.description: Packages are restored with the .NET SDK into the NuGet global packages folder of the user profile (outside the working tree); the restore writes obj/ (project.assets.json) in the working tree and a build writes bin/, both excluded by the repository's .gitignore. nuget.config of the repository names only nuget.org and places no packages folder under the working tree.
workingTreeInstall.projectItselfInstalled: no: the test project reaches the library through a ProjectReference inside the repository; no package of the project is restored from a feed or a local folder

evidenceWorkspace.description: Packages come from the NuGet global packages folder in the user profile; the test command's implicit restore produces obj/ in the workspace, and the workspace is built cold (C001-ADR-006 table, C#/.NET row). bin/ and obj/ are never copied from the working tree.

activeEnvironment.description: Any shell with the .NET SDK 10.0.x on PATH (global.json requires 10.0.0 with rollForward latestFeature), started in the repository root; nothing is activated. The test project targets net8.0, net9.0 and net10.0; the test command selects net10.0.

testCommandNotes: xUnit; builds the library and the test project, then runs 895 tests (894 pass, 1 skipped benchmark).
